result.topic_en: A torn fragment in Latin posing the problem of determining, among surfaces bounded by three straight lines, those whose (curvature?) vanishes everywhere, i.e. any part of which is finite (minimal-surface-type problem); the text is cut off at the right edge.
result.transcription:
1) Determinentur inter superficies tribus lineis rectis te
ubique evanescat seu quarum pars quaelibet {+finita+} [-sit-]

items.quote:

ubique evanescat seu quarum pars quaelibet {+finita+} [-sit-]
items.english: Let there be determined, among the surfaces [bounded/terminated] by three straight lines, [those whose ...] vanishes everywhere, or any finite part of which [... — text cut off]
